info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Creditcard Applications Decline-v4-spec
info.description: This API endpoint allows for the effective management of declined credit card applications. It provides functionality to remove a specified declined application from the system, ensuring that your application database remains accurate and up-to-date. Common consumers of this API include financial institutions and credit card companies that seek to manage applicant data efficiently. By utilizing this functionality, organizations can maintain better oversight of their application processes and improve overall operational effectiveness.

delete.description: This operation allows you to decline a specific application by its unique identifier. It is a crucial step in managing application statuses and workflows effectively.
